title: Bills 163 and 164 for 163-acre Central Maui growth
summary: The council passed Bills 163 and 164 nine to zero on September 29. They allow the Hoʻonani Village mixed-use project on 163.443 acres in Kahului. The bills change the land's community plan designation from agriculture to business and multi-family.

timeline.text: Bills 163 and 164 passed nine to zero.
Committee Chair Tamara Paltin announced the public hearing on the Maui Island Plan and Wailuku-Kahului Community Plan amendments for Hoʻonani Village.

source.quote: A public hearing on bills to update the Maui Island Plan and Wailuku-Kahului Community Plan for Central Maui's Hoʻonani Village Mixed Use Development is scheduled for Thursday at 4:30 p.m. online and in the Council Chamber, Councilmember Tamara Paltin announced today.

timeline.text: A public hearing on Bill 163 is to be held on Maui before second and final reading.
The bills would change the land's community plan designation from agriculture to business and multi-family.
The council is considering bills to allow the Hoʻonani Village mixed-use project on 163.443 acres in Kahului.
A testifier asked the council to wait for a final environmental impact statement before acting on Bills 163 and 164.
